system.description:
You can draw people to your side. You need not see or know the location of the person whose attendance you demand; as long as she is known to you, she will make all efforts to come to you. Victims do not necessarily know the source of this compulsion and might not even recognize their destination until they arrive. The compulsion lasts until the victim reaches you and makes her presence known.

Summoning calls for a Narrator's assistance. Inform the Narrator of your target, your Social Trait count, and whether you wish to use Leadership for a retest. The Narrator hunts down your victim and performs the challenge as your proxy without informing you of success or failure beyond telling you if you must mark Leadership as expended. You can only use Summon upon someone with whom you have at least a passing acquaintance. Should another Cainite attempt to Summon the same person, she goes first to the Cainite of lowest generation (ties resolved by who summoned first, or by Social Challenge if simultaneous). If you attempt to summon a false identity (e.g. crafted through Mask of a Thousand Faces), the person who wore the false identity is summoned instead.
